summary: feat(auth): count PayPal invoice and SNS publish failures in StatsD
description:
Because:
- PayPal invoice failures and failed SNS publishes are only logged, so
  Yardstick has nothing to alert on

This commit:
- Counts paypal-processor.invoice.processed and .error per invoice
- Counts notifier.publish.failure in the legacy notifier and NotifierService
- Makes StatsD a required NotifierService dependency
- Adds the matching unit test assertions

Fixes PAY-3881
